name: Condwiramur

attributes.attribute: wife of the heroic king Peredur

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Condwiramur is a Welsh heroine. In some legends she was the bride of the valiant king Peredur. She was the mother of their son Lohenergrain.

okr.objective: Condwiramur is a Welsh heroine joined to king Peredur.
key_results: In some legends she was the wife of king Peredur.
She was mother of their son Lohenergrain.
